title: 第5章 买攻略第6章 欢喜镇欲拒还迎
content_zh:
;;
敖鹏在救援点休整了半天。
他现在要解决两件事，第一件事是找个稳定的兼职工作还钱。
第二件事是找郑瀚这狗东西报仇！
若郑瀚这次帮忙垫了这笔钱，敖鹏自然会记得他的好。
但哪有别人落井里，听到后立马转身的？
而且还是你把别人带到井边的，这自然就是仇！
不过现在是新时代，别说是杀了郑瀚，就算打他一顿，敖鹏也脱不了手。
到时候别说是母亲担忧了，就算是游戏都不能玩，那才是真的断了他的前途！
想要报仇，自然先要玩好游戏。
他这二两二钱的破命，不玩好游戏是没有前途的！
有6万3千香火，敖鹏也算是一个小富翁。
他这两天认真研究了一下论坛给的明面信息。
总结出了几个规律。
第一，人为什么会被拖入这个游戏之中。
那是在现实之中遇到了鬼怪之事，并且靠自己在现实中的能力克服了鬼怪，然后就自然被这游戏找上门。
第二，这游戏开服差不多两三个月的样子，直接查最早的论坛留言就知道，现在大家都是新手期，最厉害的人也不过刚刚到城镇一级，还被卡在了那里。
敖鹏第一时间想到了弟弟敖武和母亲。
这游戏肯定是要玩的，而且越早越好。
别人无法在现实中控制鬼怪之力，但是敖鹏自己就是鬼怪！

他先是订了一张夜班车的回家票，这样不仅便宜，而且还不耽误他白天玩游戏，毕竟他是真身进入，和别人不一样。
和李存浩互相留下联系方式，告别之后，敖鹏出了门并没有立刻往车站走，而是往林子里一钻，找个没人的地开启游戏。
【卑劣的继承者啊，你再次踏上了旧土。】
得，敖鹏感觉系统对他有意见了。
一开始是新时代的继承者，然后是谨慎的继承者。
现在直接变成卑劣的继承者了。
【你的‘好邻居’们因为你的凶名都搬走了，这次你该如何选择呢，难道你要在这小庙里守一辈子，等着‘好邻居’们回来？】
敖鹏没有管系统冷嘲热讽。
他先是去论坛里面花1000香火，付费买后面的攻略。
因为有系统作为担保，所以这攻略的价格本身就是系统估价的。
“每个人的新手任务都是三条路。”
“重要的不是你选哪条路，而是你在什么地方！”
“旧土可以影响到现实，同样的，现实也可以影响到旧土！”
“开局系统让挑选的几种身份，里面大多数是常见的普通身份，绝大多数人都会接触过传教士，所以会有这个身份提示，这不是让你选的，而是系统给你的开头过关提示！”
敖鹏看了攻略的开头，就眼前一亮，果然是大佬啊。
他记得传教士的解说是‘这是外来人遗留下的信仰，在这片旧土上不管用，也许你可以另谋出路’。
其中隐含条件就是旧土广袤无垠，但是也划分片区，不同的片区有不同的特性。
content_en:
;;
Ao Peng rested for a long time at the rescue point.
He has two things to solve now. The first is to find a stable part-time job to repay the money.
The second thing is to take revenge on this bitch Zheng Han!
If Zheng Han helps advance the money this time, Ao Peng will naturally remember his kindness.
But how could anyone who fell into a well turn around immediately after hearing this?
And you were the one who brought others to the well, so naturally this is revenge!
But now is a new era, let alone killing Zheng Han, even if he is beaten, Ao Peng cannot escape.
When the time comes, let alone his mother being worried, even if he can't play games, then his future will be really cut off!
If you want to take revenge, you must first play the game well.
He has only two taels of money to lose his life. If he doesn't play the game well, he has no future!
With 63,000 incense sticks, Ao Peng can be considered a small rich man.
He carefully studied the explicit information given by the forum in the past two days.
Several rules were summarized.
First, why are people dragged into this game.
That was when I encountered a ghost in reality, and relied on my own abilities in reality to defeat the ghost, and then this game naturally came to my door.
Secondly, this game has been in service for about two or three months. If you just check the earliest forum messages, you will know that everyone is now a novice, and the most powerful people have just reached the town level and are still stuck there.
Ao Peng immediately thought of his younger brother Ao Wu and his mother.
This game definitely needs to be played, and the sooner the better.
Others cannot control the power of ghosts in reality, but Ao Peng himself is a ghost!
He first booked a night bus ticket home, which was not only cheaper, but also didn't delay him from playing games during the day. After all, he entered in person, unlike others.
He and Li Cunhao left each other's contact information. After saying goodbye, Ao Peng went out and did not go to the station immediately. Instead, he went into the forest and found a deserted place to start the game.
[Despicable successor, you have once again set foot on the old soil. 】
Yes, Ao Peng feels that the system has a problem with him.
First the New Age heirs, then the cautious heirs.
Now he has become a despicable successor.
[Your 'good neighbors' have all moved away because of your bad reputation. How should you choose this time? Do you want to stay in this small temple for the rest of your life, waiting for the 'good neighbors' to come back? 】
Ao Peng ignored the system's cynicism.
He first went to the forum and spent 1,000 incense to buy the following strategies.
Because there is a system as a guarantee, the price of this guide itself is estimated by the system.
"Everyone's novice mission is three paths."
“What matters is not which path you choose, but where you are!”
"Old soil can affect reality, and reality can also affect old soil!"
"Most of the identities that the system allows you to choose at the beginning are common ordinary identities. Most people will have come into contact with missionaries, so there will be this identity prompt. This is not for you to choose, but a prompt for you to pass the level at the beginning given by the system!"
Ao Peng read the beginning of the guide and his eyes lit up. He was indeed a boss.
He remembered the missionary’s explanation: ‘This is a belief left by outsiders. It won’t work in this old land. Maybe you can find another way out’.
The implicit condition is that the old land is vast, but it is also divided into areas, and different areas have different characteristics.
